_comment: TizenAmbilight settings. Copy to config.json in this folder, fill in, rebuild. Without a config.json this file ships as the template, and Apps2Samsung fills in the wledIp, ledCount, mapOffset, mapReverse, ppiZones and edgeTop/edgeRight/edgeBottom/edgeLeft lines below from its install form, so keep their exact formatting. Every key is optional; the README lists them all.
